posts.author: kolli_sreekanth
posts.text: Which is the best source for options historical data — I used ICICI Direct’s Breeze API to get historical data of index, options for more than 5 years for my back test and compared against zerodha api response for recent data and it matched perfectly except one caveat, when there is a gap up/gap down in the index price the breeze data shows sometimes as previous day candle close as the opening price of the today gap up cnadle. so it wont show the gap up/down in the candle data properly. except this everything seems to be fine.

posts.author: Ranjit_DailyTrader
posts.text: Which is the best source for options historical data — I had a similar requirement a while back for EOD options OHLC data for NIFTY and stocks. I ended up getting it from Accelpix. I purchased historical expired options data from them, and the process was quite straightforward. The data was available for different strikes and multiple symbols, so I didn’t have to manually collect everything from NSE. The pricing was also quite affordable compared to some of the other vendors I checked. I’m not sure about their current pricing or plans, but you can contact them and check. It might be worth tryi…
